quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 605,748 million (-3.1%), mainly on lower SPE (semiconductor production equipment) sales; operating income JPY 122,522 million (-9.7%) on higher fixed costs such as R&D and personnel expenses for growth plus the lower sales; ordinary income JPY 124,323 million (-10.1%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 92,003 million (-7.5%). SPE sales JPY 485,982 million (-6.5%): post-sales and DRAM equipment sales rose while foundry equipment sales fell; by region Taiwan rose while China and the US fell; SPE operating income JPY 122,707 million (-10.4%) - profitability improved on higher post-sales, but lower sales and higher fixed costs cut profit. Graphic Arts JPY 57,494 million (+8.5%), operating income JPY 3,602 million (-16.1%, higher fixed costs and US tariffs); Display and coating equipment (FT) JPY 44,755 million (+24.9%) on higher OLED equipment sales, operating income JPY 8,605 million (+181.8%); PCB equipment (PE) JPY 14,545 million (+2.6%), operating income JPY 383 million (-64.2%). Sales by customer location: China JPY 232,534 million (38.4%), Taiwan JPY 135,987 million (22.4%), Japan JPY 85,639 million (14.1%), US JPY 49,637 million (8.2%), South Korea JPY 39,074 million (6.5%), Europe JPY 26,055 million (4.3%), other JPY 36,819 million (6.1%). The report does not disclose orders received (the company says they fluctuate too much in the short term to indicate medium- to long-term trends).

quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term plan 'Value Up Further 2026' (FY ending March 2025 to March 2027; organic-growth targets, annual securities report): cumulative net sales of JPY 1.8 trillion or more, cumulative operating margin of 19% or more and ROIC of 15% or more in the final year; actuals were net sales JPY 625.2 billion, operating margin 21.7% and ROIC 24.7% in the year to March 2025, and JPY 605.7 billion, 20.2% and 20.0% in the year to March 2026. SPE targets: cumulative sales of JPY 1.5 trillion or more at a 23-25% operating margin (year 1: JPY 519.5 billion, 26.4%; year 2: JPY 485.9 billion, 25.2%); SPE strategy is to raise its cleaning-equipment market share, expand production capacity and strengthen the business base. Management states that the 2025 WFE market grew solidly on data-center demand for high-performance chips as AI use expanded rapidly, that WFE is expected to grow even more in 2026 as AI chip investment continues, centred on leading-edge investment by major foundries and memory makers, and that China is expected to keep investing in relatively advanced nodes aimed at domestic AI chip production; SCREEN will build up production while improving efficiency to capture the strongly growing WFE investment. FT targets cumulative sales of JPY 100 billion or more (year 2: JPY 44.7 billion, 19.2% margin) and will take in the panel-level advanced packaging business; in PE, package-related investment in South Korea and China recovered from late in the year to March 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Mid-term plan: cumulative sales JPY 1.8 trillion+, operating margin 19%+, ROIC 15%+; SPE cumulative JPY 1.5 trillion+ at 23-25% margin

quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 37,777 million - SPE JPY 23,160 million, GA JPY 2,561 million, FT JPY 391 million, PE JPY 838 million, other (advanced packaging, life science and hydrogen new businesses, basic research) JPY 10,825 million. SPE developed the DW-3100 direct-write exposure system for the advanced semiconductor packaging market, which the company says achieves world-class high resolution; in leading-edge devices it signed an additional contract with IBM on next-generation cleaning process development and continues research with imec and other overseas institutes. FT developed new models of its Lemotia coating-and-drying system for advanced packaging that handle 300 x 300 mm and 310 x 310 mm panel substrates; PE developed LUPIOS, a direct imaging system for mid-range package substrates (demand rising with AI), and SpairD, a substrate repair system.

quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging and R&D bases (annual securities report): in September 2025 SCREEN took over Nikon's wafer bonding R&D business, aiming to combine Nikon's ultra-high-precision bonding technology and know-how with its own to reach world-class bonding technology and establish a presence in advanced packaging; in April 2026 the advanced packaging business office was moved into the FT segment to integrate development, manufacturing, sales and service. SCREEN Advanced Technology Center of America, LLC was set up in New York in December 2025 as an SPE R&D base, which the company expects to shorten development of element technologies and equipment in cleaning (where it claims the top share), thermal processing and advanced packaging. The company is also considering M&A, mainly in SPE, and is strategically acquiring land in Yasu, Shiga for future business expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: Nikon wafer bonding R&D business acquired September 2025; ATCA R&D base established December 2025
